summary: @ornikar/eslint-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: This package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) automatically fires on `npm install`. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with hex-mangled identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, string-map wrappers) that mask ordinary fs/https/zlib/execFileSync calls; it downloads the Bun runtime tarball from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, extracts it, chmod +x's the binary, and invokes it against a bundled 727KB single-line obfuscator.io-style file `math_init.js` (marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`, containing a shuffled string array `n7gIxM` and rotation routine `WV8StW`). An eslint-config package has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime or ship a large opaque compiled-for-Bun payload; using Bun to run the payload also side-steps Node-based inspection. The combination of a preinstall dropper, an obfuscated install script, and an obfuscated bundled payload executed by the fetched alternate runtime is a supply-chain attack pattern that yields arbitrary code execution on every installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
